model_proposal_source: Existing v0.22 authenticated Codex completions, no new inference calls

metric_definitions.actual_public_evaluator_calls: Number of actual sandbox Docker public test invocations, excluding verified replay receipts
metric_definitions.actual_git_apply_calls: Number of actual disposable Git patch applications, excluding verified replay receipts
metric_definitions.same_correctness: Exact final public + heldout hidden outcomes equal in both ordinary and shared conditions
metric_definitions.wall_time_seconds: Elapsed wall time of end-to-end condition including host overhead and hidden grading; unpaired order and Docker cache subject to confounding
metric_definitions.calls_saved: Ordinary public grading calls minus verified-shared public grading calls; excludes original v0.22 model cost

trust_boundary: No cached arbitrary user verdicts; receipt copied only from matching host-owned session, same evaluator sha, candidate source hash, original upstream source SHA, exact patch bytes SHA, same decision and ancestry; no hidden outcomes returned to model; no original working repo edits
